candidate.name: Shimura Curve Uniform Quaternionic Descent
candidate.text: Candidate: Shimura curves associated to indefinite quaternion algebras over totally real fields. Because Shimura curves have no real points (no cusps), rational points on twisted Shimura curves X_D are empty for all discriminants D > 1, providing a uniform topological obstruction for Beal solutions.

legend.1: level 1: depends on open conjectures (e.g. general Shimura curve modularity over non-totally real fields)
legend.2: level 2: grounded in proved theorems (Darmon 2000, Khare-Wintenberger, Mazur) with concrete lemmas to formalize
legend.3: level 3: complete reduction to exact computable certificates
